notes: All to sheep, Send next 3 @unit_worker/villager.webp@to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.

Age up with 3 @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@

Rally to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ UNTIL 9!
It should look like this after completed eco-buildings.
With two of the villagers building the Landmark, build the first @building_lancaster/manor.webp@.
Rally to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ UNTIL 10. Because we want@technology_lancaster/condensed_land_practices.webp@ to get 6 manors.
Halfway done on the second manor, send all the @resource/resource_food.webp@villagers to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Rally to @resource/resource_food.webp@ when you have 10 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@incl. the one's building the manor(s).
Get @technology_lancaster/condensed_land_practices.webp@ to build last 3 @building_lancaster/manor.webp@. Build the next 2 @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ when you can.
When enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@to build last manor (200) move the @resource/resource_wood.webp@villagers to @resource/resource_food.webp@.
When enough @resource/resource_stone.webp@to build the last manor (100) move them to @resource/resource_gold.webp@.

With 12 villagers from @resource/resource_food.webp@ build @landmark_english/the-white-tower.webp@ protecting gold.
Build 2 @building_military/stable.webp@ with @resource/resource_food.webp@villagers.
Send 5 @resource/resource_food.webp@villagers to @resource/resource_wood.webp@.
Continue just rally to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Rally to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
